name: HR - Payroll Calculation

parameters.query: SELECT e.id as employee_id, e.full_name, e.base_salary, e.tenant_id, COUNT(a.id) as worked_days, SUM(a.worked_hours) as total_hours, COUNT(CASE WHEN lr.status='APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as leave_days FROM hr_employees e LEFT JOIN hr_attendance_logs a ON a.employee_id = e.id AND date_trunc('month', a.check_in_time) = date_trunc('month', NOW()) LEFT JOIN hr_leave_requests lr ON lr.employee_id = e.id AND date_trunc('month', lr.start_date) = date_trunc('month', NOW()) AND lr.status = 'APPROVED' WHERE e.status = 'ACTIVE' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY e.id, e.full_name, e.base_salary, e.tenant_id;

INSERT INTO hr_payroll_records (tenant_id, employee_id, period, worked_days, overtime_hours, gross_salary, tax_amount, social_insurance, net_salary, status, generated_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,'DRAFT',NOW()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, employee_id, period) DO UPDATE SET gross_salary=$6, net_salary=$9, status='DRAFT';
SELECT m.mattermost_user_id FROM hr_payroll_config m WHERE m.tenant_id = $1 LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_employees, SUM(net_salary) as total_payroll FROM hr_payroll_records WHERE period = $1 AND status = 'DRAFT';
